actions.action: Add a keyboard-operated “Move to position” command.
actions.mechanism: An explicit destination moves any item without dragging or repeatedly stepping through forty positions.
actions.implementation: Give each item a button opening a labeled integer field, accepting 1–40. Commit by splicing its existing ID into the requested final position.
actions.check: Using only Tab, typing, and Enter, move item 37 to position 2; verify all forty IDs remain unchanged.
actions.risk: Clearly label positions as one-based; reject invalid input.

actions.action: Offer “Move before or after another item.”
actions.mechanism: A named destination lets users choose placement without knowing the target’s numerical position.
actions.implementation: Provide keyboard-accessible target and before/after selectors. Exclude the moving item; resolve the target by ID after removing the source from the order.
actions.check: Move an item before and after targets on either side; verify adjacent placement and an unchanged ID set.
actions.risk: Disambiguate duplicate titles with their current positions.

actions.action: Keep every committed move undoable throughout the page.
actions.mechanism: A page-lifetime history restores prior ID sequences rather than attempting potentially ambiguous inverse movements.
actions.implementation: Before either move command commits, push the current ID order onto an uncapped session stack. Provide a keyboard-accessible Undo button; never expire entries by timer.
actions.check: Perform fifty mixed moves, wait, then undo all fifty; require exact restoration of the starting sequence.
actions.risk: Other list mutations require an explicit compatible history policy.

actions.action: Preserve focus and announce each ordering change.
actions.mechanism: Stable focus and spoken status make committed moves and reversals observable without a pointer or visual tracking.
actions.implementation: Key rendered items by existing IDs. After moving or undoing, focus the affected item’s move button and announce its title and final position through a polite live region.
actions.check: With keyboard and screen reader, move and undo an item; verify focus follows its ID and each resulting position is announced.
actions.risk: Rerendering must not duplicate announcements or reset focus.
